name: Hajimete no Kanojo
source:
Takagi Noriaki is an average college student quickly approaching his 20th birthday. Having missed his opportunity to confess to his crush of 6 years, he spends his listless days dreaming of the love that could have been. 

Tired of being teased by his friends for being childish and overly dramatic for being unable to let go of his love, Noriaki resolves to overwrite his remorseful love with new love. Uncertain of where to start, he consults the manager at his part-time job who suggests going losing his virginity to a soapland girl to wipe the slate clean. 

Doing what all youngsters do, Noriaki researches soaplands online prior to visiting in order to prepare himself for the unknown adult world. "Be on the lookout for photoshopped pictures", "you get what you paid for", "a waist measurement of 58 is the danger zone". Noriaki picks up all sorts of random information - but as he is about to call it a night - a picture catches his eyes. 

To his disbelief, it's Yukimiya Akino, his love of 6 years. 

With renewed vigor and a conviction to seize the second wind he was given, Noriaki makes his soapland debut.
translation:
高木典明是一名即将迎来20岁生日的普通大学生。由于错过了向暗恋六年的人表白的机会，他在无精打采的日子里梦想着本来可以实现的爱情。

厌倦了被朋友们嘲笑为幼稚和过于戏剧化而无法放开自己的爱，典明决定用新的爱情来覆盖他悔恨的爱情。由于不确定从哪里开始，他咨询了兼职经理，经理建议他向一个肥皂剧女孩失去童贞，以洗清历史。

和所有年轻人一样，纪明在访问肥皂地之前先在网上研究肥皂地，以便为未知的成人世界做好准备。“留意经过修图的照片”、“一分钱一分货”、“腰围58是危险区”。典明收集到了各种各样的随机信息 - 但当他准备收工时 - 一张照片引起了他的注意。

令他难以置信的是，这是他相恋六年的雪宫秋野。

带着新的活力和抓住第二次机会的信念，典明首次在肥皂剧中亮相。
